news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Clarify Controversy Over Single-Take Artist Line in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently addressed the backlash surrounding a specific dialogue in their film The Paradise. The director explained that the line was meant to highlight ironic realization, but the crucial backstory was edited out, leading to audience confusion. Meanwhile, the movie produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri with music by Anirudh Ravichander is steadily approaching the Rs. 150 crore gross milestone by the end of its opening weekend.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Exhibits Retro Styling in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu has shared a fresh set of images showcasing a vintage-inspired fashion look featuring voluminous curls and a floral mini dress. The actor, who has previously spoken openly about facing industry hurdles, is currently filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? where she plays ACP Komal Sharma. Her recent silver screen outings in 2026 faced box office struggles.

news.title: Makers Maintain Original Release Schedule for Sambarala Yeti Gattu
news.summary: The team behind the mass action entertainer Sambarala Yeti Gattu has confirmed that the film will stick to its planned Sankranti release on January 12, 2027. Despite overlapping release announcements from other major projects, producer Chaitanya Reddy stated that post-production is nearing completion and they will not exit the festive race. The Rohith KP directorial stars Sai Durga Tej in the lead alongside a prominent ensemble cast.

news.title: Hombale Films Steps In to Distribute Hanuman Ansh Across Southern Markets
news.summary: Following its massive box office run in Hindi, the low-budget biographical drama Hanuman Ansh is expanding to southern languages with Hombale Films acquiring regional dubbing rights. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi and based on his book Divine Detour: That Changed My Life, the trilogy's first installment chronicles the early journey of Neem Karoli Baba. The project features Shobhinaw Satyaa as the protagonist in a pre-Independence setting.

news.title: NTR Set to Revive Dragon Filming in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a brief recovery period from a shoulder injury, prominent actor NTR is gearing up to participate in the upcoming shooting schedule for Dragon starting October 10. Director Prashanth Neel has kept production moving by focusing on scenes that do not require the lead star. The upcoming schedule in Mumbai will feature a high-voltage action stunt sequence lasting over two weeks.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is moving swiftly toward wrapping up his upcoming directorial venture, January 12 Vidudala, with filming entering its final stages. Following a brief pause, the production crew is set to resume work in Ooty during the first week of October, followed by overseas song sequences. The team expects to complete all filming by mid-November, leaving ample time for post-production before the scheduled January 12 theatrical release.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Box Office Momentum
news.summary: The Paradise continues to enjoy strong and consistent box office numbers following its record-breaking opening weekend. Family audiences and moviegoers turned out in large numbers on the holiday, driving high and steady advance bookings. This stellar performance highlights Nani's strong star power and the tremendous theatrical reception for the Srikanth Odela directorial.

news.title: Chakkora Theatrical Trailer Unveils a Twist-Filled Romance
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird, launched in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh, highlights a unique blend of romance, family emotions, and mystery. The story follows a carefree young man whose world turns upside down after the sudden disappearance of the woman he loves. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie features music by Prince Henry and is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nitesh Tiwari's Epic Ramayana Reveals Striking New Character Stills
news.summary: Director Nitesh Tiwari's highly anticipated project Ramayana has shared fresh promotional material highlighting its main characters. The newly released imagery showcases Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as the divine trio alongside a regal first look of Yash as Ravana. The film's first installment is slated to debut during Diwali 2026.

news.title: Aakash Jagannadh Launches Chakkora Trailer in Hyderabad
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for the romantic drama Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird was officially unveiled by actor Aakash Jagannadh in Hyderabad. Helmed by debutant director Manga Srinivas, the movie stars Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in pivotal roles. The project is scheduled for a global theatrical launch on October 9.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum Despite Mixed Reviews
news.summary: Nani's latest outing, The Paradise, has continued its solid theatrical run by recording impressive collections over the weekend. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the movie crossed the 136 crore global gross mark in its first three days. Strong domestic and overseas ticket sales indicate a positive trend heading into the upcoming weekdays.

news.title: NTR Readies to Join Mumbai Schedule for Prashanth Neel's Dragon
news.summary: Actor NTR is set to return to film sets following his recovery from a shoulder surgery that kept him away for nearly two months. He will resume shooting for Prashanth Neel's directorial venture Dragon in Mumbai starting October 10. The upcoming 15-day schedule will feature major action sequences involving NTR and Anil Kapoor.

news.title: Nani's High-Stakes Venture 'The Paradise' Confronts Crucial Box Office Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget starrer The Paradise opened to massive numbers despite receiving a mixed critical response regarding its narrative flow and emotional connection. Having accumulated an estimated ₹120 crore gross by Saturday with projections reaching close to ₹150 crore by Sunday, the movie faces a vital test to meet its ₹220 crore gross objective. With no major competing releases next week, its performance from Monday onward will ultimately determine its financial outcome across various territories.

news.title: Makers of 'Ramayana' Unveil Striking New Character Posters Ahead of Diwali Releases
news.summary: The ambitious multi-part adaptation Ramayana has revealed two brand-new character posters highlighting key figures from the epic narrative. Featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, the project is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced on a global scale by Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations. With music composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer, the pan-Indian film is slated for theatrical debuts during Diwali in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Nagarjuna's Milestone Project 'King100' Set to Reveal Tabu's Character Teaser
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark film King100 is preparing to launch a special video introduction for Tabu, who stars as one of the project's three female leads alongside Sushmita Bhat. This upcoming release marks a major onscreen reunion for Nagarjuna and Tabu, who previously paired up in the classic 1990s hit Ninne Pelladutha. Helmed by director Ra Karthik with music by Devi Sri Prasad, the movie is scheduled to hit theaters on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Team 'Ranabaali' Gears Up to Launch Four-Part Promotional Documentary Series
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming historical drama Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda, is set to release a four-part promotional docu-series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The project draws from two years of historical research into British suppression in Rayalaseema and features insights from the lead cast and director. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers with a musical score by Ajay-Atul, the film is slated for a theatrical release on October 16, 2026.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Steady Box Office Momentum in Nizam
news.summary: The Nani-starrer action drama The Paradise performed consistently on its third day in the Nizam region. Helmed by director Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film brought its total share close to Rs. 23 crore as it heads into the weekend.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR watched the Nani-starrer The Paradise at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the movie for its authentic representation of Telangana culture, language, and the struggles of an oppressed community against injustice.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger OTT Value for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Recent reports indicate that digital streaming platforms are offering higher valuations for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media reach.

news.title: The Paradise Registers Steady BookMyShow Ticket Sales on Day Three
news.summary: Despite encountering mixed initial talk, the Nani-starrer The Paradise kept up strong digital ticket sales on BookMyShow, moving 252K tickets on its third day. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the big-budget actioner continues to draw audiences following its strong opening weekend numbers.

news.title: Wildcard Contestant Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising development on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, newly entered wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a 15 lakh rupee cash offer and chose to walk out. Having spent just 24 hours inside the house, he explained his exit by stating that the prevailing dynamics would prevent him from winning the title.

news.title: Nani Extols Cast and Crew at The Paradise Press Meet
news.summary: During a media interaction in Hyderabad for his movie The Paradise, actor Nani praised the relentless efforts of his technical team, assistant directors, and co-stars. He specifically commended the contributions of actor Mohan Babu and director Srikanth Odela while describing the film as a long-distance runner at the box office.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise His Most Dangerous Yet
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu revealed that his character in the Nani-starrer The Paradise is the most menacing role he has taken on across his five-decade career. Speaking at a press event, he lauded director Srikanth Odela's storytelling abilities and praised producer Sudhakar for his uncompromising support of the project.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Paradise Box Office Turnaround
news.summary: Actor Nani expressed delight over the audience reception of The Paradise, noting that the film experienced a rare reversal from initial negative reactions to overwhelming positivity with each passing screening. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the project features a stellar ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, and Sonali Kulkarni.
